about: Test values of the moments engine (tools/dayrec/moments.py, README "The moments"). Each case: the final result of a case of dayrec-cases.json (by name, expected.final), the history before it, and the expected output, to match exactly. chain: the same days one after another, each starting from the history the previous one returned. lift_cards: the card on the lift from the final analysis of the log so far (inline).
